column1: # Hotspot patterns for hotspots.sh. Each hit is a lead to inspect, not a finding.
# Columns, separated by tabs: path regex, added-line regex (POSIX ERE), label.
# Comment lines are skipped: // in Swift, # in Python and TOML, -- in SQL.

column3: GCD: use async/await, actors, or Mutex
Task.detached: usually @concurrent or structured concurrency instead
@unchecked Sendable: verify real locking or restructure
nonisolated(unsafe): only for provably immutable state
continuation: must resume exactly once on every path
AsyncStream closure init: prefer makeStream(of:); check finish()
MainActor.run: likely redundant with default MainActor isolation
use Task.sleep(for:)
unstructured Task: errors handled? in a loop? cancelled when replaced?
force try or cast
possible force unwrap
print(): show errors via userMessage(for:) or use Logger
empty catch: error swallowed
try?: make sure a user-facing failure is not swallowed
fatalError: only for truly unrecoverable states
deprecated SwiftUI modifier
legacy API
deprecated placement: use a semantic toolbar placement
use .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
animation without value:
one-parameter onChange: use the 0- or 2-parameter form
onTapGesture: use a Button unless location or count is needed
legacy observation: use @Observable
@State is not private
GeometryReader: prefer containerRelativeFrame, visualEffect, or Layout
AnyView: avoid type erasure
Binding(get:set:): bind to a property instead
ForEach identity: needs stable element ids
layout from idiom or != .compact: use size classes and == .regular
unqualified ignoresSafeArea: fine for backgrounds only
fixed or tiny font: Dynamic Type
use bold()
onAppear: async work belongs in .task
UI string literal: use a generated catalog symbol (fine in #Preview)
legacy formatting: use FormatStyle
use LocalizedStringResource
user-text matching: use localizedStandardContains
use count(where:)
use Date.now
use replacing(_:with:)
prefer Double unless an API needs CGFloat
Combine: prefer Observation or async sequences
URLSession outside Data/App: go through a client and HTTPClient
direct URLSession use: clients call their injected HTTPClient
hidden UserDefaults dependency: go through TargetsStore
singleton: dependencies go through AppDependencies
plain queryItems: use setStrictlyEncodedQueryItems
URL built by string interpolation
Domain must not depend on UI, persistence, or networking
model change: needs a new VersionedSchema and MigrationStage?
schema or migration plan change: verify the upgrade path
predicate: check runtime-safe operations only
in a #Predicate this crashes at runtime: use !isEmpty
relationship: explicit deleteRule and inverse?
uniqueness turns inserts into upserts: intended?
@Query: only valid inside SwiftUI views
bulk delete: check the predicate is tight
new ModelContext: check actor isolation and save path
plain http URL: ATS
possible real API key
ATS exception
logging: check privacy annotations, no URLs with api_key
XCTest in unit tests: use Swift Testing
negation inside #expect: write == false
timing-based wait in a test
.serialized only affects parameterized tests
expect a specific error, not Error.self
live network or shared defaults: use MockHTTPClient and IsolatedDefaults
use AppModelContainer.make(inMemory: true)
timeLimit only accepts .minutes
bare @Suite is unnecessary
use waitForExistence instead of sleeping
deployment target changed
new package dependency
hand-added file reference: targets use synchronized groups
core build setting changed
catalog key not manual
non-positional placeholder: use %1$@ and describe it in the comment
async def: nothing blocking and no session inside (routes here are plain def)
blocking call: fine in def, never in async def
print(): use logging
default-value dependency: use Annotated[...]
service imports fastapi: raise an AppError subclass instead
HTTPException: raise an AppError subclass so the error code stays stable
broad except: catch specific exceptions, re-raise in yield dependencies
create_all outside tests: schema changes go in migrations/
outdated API (backend/SKILL.md §18 and §19)
CORS wildcard: list exact origins
noqa without a reason after it

column1: # Backend: security, data and the API contract

column3: route: CurrentUserDep, response_model, ErrorEnvelope responses, README table, app client
user id as a route parameter: take the acting user from CurrentUserDep
jwt.decode: pass algorithms=[...] and check the token type
logging a secret?
naive datetime: use datetime.now(UTC)
unbounded str or list: add max_length if clients send it
schema change: does the app's Gramwise client still decode it?
model change: needs a matching migrations/NNNN_*.sql
new table: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, and a matching SQLModel model
destructive change: existing rows and installed app builds still fine?
dependency added or changed: needs the owner's approval
possible live network in a test: use httpx.MockTransport
override: cleared in teardown (the client fixture does this)?
timing-based wait in a test
